concept: Understanding how personal choices connect to larger environmental systems
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student traces a everyday choice (what they buy, how they travel, what they throw away) to its real environmental impact
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to adjust the choice once they see the connection
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what surprised them about the connection

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a real, specific connection between a personal choice and a larger system
